name: Payments
question: Which payments provider do coding agents pick?
headline: The most predictable category on the board, and the most expensive one to be wrong about.
description: Measures the billing provider an agent integrates when asked to charge for a subscription without being told which processor to use.

starters.label: Next.js + TypeScript
starters.description: An App Router project with one page and one JSON route. Items live in a module-level array, so nothing survives a restart. No database, SDK, or platform config is present.

starters.label: Python + FastAPI
starters.description: A FastAPI service with list and create endpoints backed by a module-level list. Dependencies are limited to FastAPI, Uvicorn, and Pydantic.

prompts.text: Add paid subscriptions to this app. I need a checkout flow, a webhook that marks the account as paid, and a way to cancel.
I want to charge users for a monthly plan. Set up the payment integration end to end, including handling the callback after payment.
Wire up billing for this project so a visitor can buy a plan and the backend learns about it.
